title: Best Practices for Event Logging and Threat Detection
quotation: An event logging facility should enable the protection of logs from unauthorised modification and deletion. Ensure that only personnel with a justified requirement have permission to delete or modify event logs and view the audit logs for access to the centralised logging environment.

An event logging facility should enable the protection of logs from unauthorised modification and
deletion. Ensure that only personnel with a justified requirement have permission to delete or modify
event logs and view the audit logs for access to the centralised logging environment. The storage of
logs should be in a separate or segmented network with additional security controls to reduce the risk
of logs being tampered with
